# S5.1 — Profile Compiler rule family + router bandit (§5b)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.16c` (PR #82) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the Profile Compiler rule family and the router
`bandit` family under the `offline-only` budget
(`R-2.3.3`, `R-2.3.2`, `R-2.3.4²`, `R-2.1.4¹ᵇ`): probes,
chains, renderer/tool-shape families and expiry as ledger
events; the plan-time `validate_assembly` stage 6b
`C-PROF-2` compiled-surface check; `bandit`-class routing
policies; and the K6 semantic cache with its mandatory
verifier and `readers` scoping — closing DF-S4.16a-1.

**Profile Compiler family** (`R-2.3.3`): `hh-compiler`
gains `probe.rs` (a pure `probe_profile(driver)` fold —
`probe_specs`, deterministic `probe_run_id`,
`probed_payload`, a bounded/probe-safe regex engine) and
`expiry.rs` (`ExpiryObservables` → `StatusTransition`:
`evaluate_expiry` is a pure fold over the declared
observables — date/window, probe-failure, dependency
expiry, evidence staleness, experiment settlement;
`expired`/`retired` terminal inside the fold, `expired →
retired` only through the human-sealed path). The
`model.profile.*` ledger events mint through
`hh_gateway::events` — `status.changed`, `probed`,
`expired_used`, `surface.relowered`. `link` takes
`intent_ref`: compile under expired rules without one
refuses `expired_without_intent`; with one it lands the
`expired_used` record (§5b.3 d.6). A served-endpoint
compatibility-token change raises
`SnapshotClaimKind::CompatibilityTokenChanged` and gates
the next `open_call` until the surface relowers
(`model.surface.relowered{compatibility_token_changed}`)
— `AC-R-2.3.3-9`.

**`ModelRoleTable` realization** (`AC-R-2.3.3-11`,
CF-313): `hh-gateway::router::ModelRoleTable` gets the
codec (the closed `ModelRole` set gates decode — the
pre-ratification `summarizer`/`shim_interpreter`
spellings never decode), `semantic_id` (the idp/1 address
of the canonical record) and the `profile_binding`
projection. `open_session`'s `profile_binding` member now
realizes the table: `primary` defaults to the
definition's pinned `native.profile`; declared roles bind
the scripted kernel port under their own coordinates
(resolved → canonical `id@version`; unresolvable → the
declared coordinate verbatim, never a substituted
record). `configuration_id.model_ref` is the table's
`semantic_id`; the manifest records
`profile_binding{roles, fallback_used}` and `expired_used`;
`model_profile_ref` carries the resolved record's
`version_id` (the only spelling `open_run`'s pin gate
admits). An expired bound profile requires the row's
`intent_ref` — absent → `Refused{expired_without_intent}`;
present → `model.profile.expired_used` mints at open.
Unknown roles refuse `SchemaViolation{unknown_role}`.

**Stage 6b `C-PROF-2`** (`R-2.1.4¹ᵇ`):
`AssemblyService::assemble` runs the compiled-surface
check at plan time — after ordinary validation succeeds,
plan mode collects `bound_profile_coordinates` and invokes
`hh_compiler::compile` through `RegistryProfiles` (the one
registry view `plan` and `lab.assembly.compile` share —
the adapter's home moved from `hh-embed` to `hh-lab`,
CC1/CC7). `UnexpressibleSurface` mints `C-PROF-2`
(error); `PlanError → C-PLAN-2`; `NoProfile → C-LINK-2`;
compiler-minted diagnostics pass through; a link refusal
carrying no diagnostics (unresolvable coordinate,
untested/invalid profile, drift, expired-without-intent)
surfaces as a stage-6 **warning** carrying the typed
`LinkErrorKind` — never a silent pass (CC3), never a
pre-empted compile refusal (CC10). `Seal` mode and hosted
roots keep their existing verdicts.

**Router `bandit`** (`R-2.3.2`, `AC-R-2.3.2-12`):
`RoutingPolicyKind::Bandit` joins the closed sum as a
conditioned rule — a bandit policy without a complete
`AssumptionDebtRecord` refuses `missing_debt_record`
(ADR-0189). Parameters are a closed object (`min_n`, UCB
exploration coefficient, `lambda` cost dock); reward
projects through `BanditView` over the declared
`task_class` — cells never pool; selection is a
deterministic argmax over declared inputs, unknown cells
read the cold-start prior (never an invented score).

**K6 semantic cache** (`R-2.3.4²`, DF-S4.16a-1):
`hh-context/src/k6.rs` — `lookup(request_embedding,
threshold, scope{principal, readers})` over a
cosine-similarity ppm index. `exact` hits serve; `marginal`
hits serve only after the registered verifier's `pass`
(`marginal_without_verifier`/`verifier_failed` refuse,
never silently serve), then promote. `readers` is a
mandatory key member — a `delegate`/`external`-written
entry never serves into a context its `readers` doesn't
name. `verifier_verdict` rides `model.cache.resolved`
durably; `false_hit_rate` accrues per profile; drift-marked
and revoked dependencies withhold.
